# Gust

> Animated text transitions for React. Pass a string as `value`; when it changes, Gust animates the characters that changed. Package: @maniktherana/gust.

## Docs

- [Agent guide](https://gust.manikrana.dev/gust.md): install, usage, every prop with its default, recipes and common mistakes. Read this before writing code.
- [README](https://github.com/Maniktherana/gust#readme): install and props on GitHub.

## Install

- [npm package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@maniktherana/gust): `npm i @maniktherana/gust`, then import `@maniktherana/gust/styles.css` once.
- [shadcn registry item](https://gust.manikrana.dev/r/gust.json): `npx shadcn@latest add https://gust.manikrana.dev/r/gust.json`.

## Optional

- [Live demos](https://gust.manikrana.dev): interactive examples of Gust in product UI, on the landing page.
